programs.name: Informatics
programs.description: Research-oriented Master of Science in Informatics. The official page describes a two-stage aptitude assessment.

requirement.previous_study_notes: The official page states that an equivalent bachelor's degree in Informatics or Computer Science is required; individual curriculum equivalence is assessed by TUM.
requirement.notes: English proficiency proof is required. The official page lists additional documents and applicant-specific conditions; no universal numeric IELTS or GPA threshold is entered here.

programs.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programs.description: Master of Science in Computer Science and Engineering, taught in English at Milano Leonardo.

requirement.previous_study_notes: A first-level degree is required. Admission depends on prior studies and assessment by Politecnico di Milano.
requirement.notes: The official program page states that a minimum grade average and proof of English are required, but does not give a universal numeric threshold for this applicant category.

programs.name: Computer Science MSc
programs.description: English-taught Computer Science MSc. The official listing states September 2027 intake and a two-year duration.

requirement.previous_study_notes: A BSc in Computer Science, or at least 60 ECTS in informatics and mathematics subjects during a related bachelor's degree, is required. Individual assessment remains with ELTE.
requirement.notes: B2 English proficiency is stated for oral and written skills; an English examination certificate is preferred but not required. An online entrance exam and interview are described on the official page.

programs.name: Master in Management
programs.source_publisher: Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management
programs.description: Bilingual Master in Management offered to international applicants in the 2027 intake.

requirement.previous_study_notes: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent; Tsinghua reviews the full application.
requirement.notes: The 2027 admission page lists HSK band 5 with a score of at least 180, with documented exemption routes. Citizenship and scholarship rules require individual review.
requirement.source_publisher: Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships
scholarships.description: Selected Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters may offer competitive full scholarships. Application and eligibility depend on the individual consortium and programme.
scholarships.eligible_nationalities: Applications are open worldwide; individual programme conditions apply.
scholarships.funding_components: Participation costs; contribution to travel, visa and living allowance where a scholarship is awarded.
